stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.15 — Observation-operator Manuscript Bridge, Claim Compression & Cross-generation Argument Court

promoted_principles.generation_not_version: Do not open a new measurement generation merely because R1.15 is a new version. ROUX-MEASUREMENT-G4 remains current because R1.14 ended in DATA_WAIT rather than measurement failure.
promoted_principles.inheritance_not_rewrite: Preserve RETAIN/DOWNGRADE/RETIRE/MUTATE/FORK/RECOMBINE/UNRESOLVED histories instead of rewriting failed operators as if they never existed.
promoted_principles.writing_as_epistemic_stress: Draft argument, abstract, figure narrative, and referee memo may expose missing evidence and generate new research tasks, but no drafted sentence is evidence.
promoted_principles.can_continue_vs_should_continue: A technically available next analysis is not automatically justified; manuscript debt and marginal information value may dominate another model/metric iteration.
promoted_principles.provenance_family_not_item_count: Claims supported by multiple artifacts from one development lineage must be stress-tested at the lineage/family level, not counted as independent evidence items.
promoted_principles.human_gate_not_synthetic_substitute: If a claim eventually requires human evidence, more synthetic sophistication cannot erase that gate.
promoted_principles.immutable_base_incremental_patch: Sealed R1.8–R1.14 artifacts remain immutable evidence bases; R1.15 adds a manuscript/claim layer rather than rewriting scientific bytes.
promoted_principles.memory_relation_specific: Intent, actuality, claim authority, and continuation state are tracked separately; no universal status rank collapses them.

RITHM_PAPER: work in small verified section units
perform evidence/claim surgery before prose polishing
maintain a Korean semantic master before English realization
return literature/evidence gaps discovered in writing back to research rather than papering them over
KSGT_JUDGE: separate reproducibility/package evidence from effect/scientific claims
make limitations and source-status first-class manuscript objects
EvoNOMOS: generation transition requires ontology/theory/data/measurement/court/authority change, not ordinary version advance
repairs may preserve scientific bytes while changing validators or execution plumbing
PEA_SCOPE: preserve partial-resumable and schema-drift states rather than silently normalizing them
KSGT: defer human recruitment until synthetic/adversarial work no longer closes the relevant evidence debt
keep productive spin-offs from displacing the original research question

r115_module_posture.writing_role: epistemic stress test and compression layer

status_board_contract.active_definition: can be resumed/executed in a subsequent research turn without external dependency
status_board_contract.roux_watch: Run irregularly during substantive CUBE-REV research turns after any required pre-outcome seal; never by silently changing G4 freshness definitions.
